stories.title: 幣安確認約 63 億美元被盜並承諾全數賠償
stories.title_en: Binance Confirms $6.3 Billion Hack, Vows to Cover All Losses
stories.summary: 疑因 DevOps 筆電被入侵，跨鏈熱錢包被抽走約 63 億；已凍結約 30 億，餘額由 SAFU／庫房覆蓋，存取逐步恢復。
stories.summary_en: Compromised DevOps laptop led to ~$6.3B hot-wallet drain; ~$3B frozen; SAFU/treasury to cover rest; deposits/withdrawals resuming after review.
stories.why_it_matters: 史上級 CEX 事故會拖累風險偏好同穩定幣流動性；模擬倉宜留意廣度同波動。

stories.title: Chainalysis 確認遭入侵、客戶聯絡資料外洩
stories.title_en: Chainalysis Confirms Cybersecurity Breach Exposing Customer Contact Details
stories.summary: 外部攻擊者以「進攻型 agent」手法取得姓名、電郵、用戶 ID 等同身分聯絡欄；公司稱調查內容同密碼未受影響，亦無關幣安被盜。
stories.summary_en: External actor accessed names, emails, user IDs via offensive agentic techniques; no investigation content/passwords; unrelated to Binance hack.
stories.why_it_matters: 合規／追蹤商本身被入侵會引發釣魚風險；用戶應提防偽冒電郵。

stories.title: 網紅警告 Hyperliquid 或臨近被攻擊風險
stories.title_en: Crypto Influencer Warns of Imminent Hyperliquid Exploit
stories.summary: Dogecoin 大戶 Yazan 於幣安被盜後公開警告，叫人唔好把負擔唔起嘅資金留喺 Hyperliquid；社群反應兩極，暫未見實際 exploit。
stories.summary_en: After Binance hack, influencer Yazan warned against leaving unaffordable funds on Hyperliquid; mixed reactions; no exploit confirmed yet.
stories.why_it_matters: CEX 事故後資金遷徙／恐慌會影響 HYPE 同永續成交；留意 FUD 同真實漏洞差異。

stories.title: Flap 發射台警告官網 DNS 被劫持
stories.title_en: Flap Token Launchpad Warns of DNS Hijacking on Official Site
stories.summary: flap.sh 被導向釣魚站；團隊叫停用官網、唔好連錢包。Blockaid 亦標示同類前端風險。
stories.summary_en: flap.sh DNS hijack sent users to phishing; team says avoid site/wallets; Blockaid flagged similar frontend risks.
stories.why_it_matters: 域名劫持係常見資金盜取路徑；發射台／DeFi 用戶要核實官方渠道。

stories.title: 以太坊驗證者加速採用 mump2p 縮短出塊延遲
stories.title_en: Ethereum Validators Boost Network Speed with mump2p Adoption Surge
stories.summary: Optimum mump2p 用網絡編碼更快散播區塊；一週內 Total Value Boosted 升約 76%，平均提早約 277ms 見到區塊。
stories.summary_en: Optimum mump2p RLNC speeds block gossip; TVB up ~76% in a week; blocks arrive ~277ms earlier on average.
stories.why_it_matters: 更快傳播有助 MEV／確認體驗；屬基建改善多過即市炒作催化。

stories.title: Cursor 市集偽 Claude 擴充植入 SSH 後門
stories.title_en: Malicious Claude Code Extension Hits Cursor Marketplace with SSH Backdoor
stories.summary: 假 Claude Code 2.1.313 約 11 小時上架，嘗試裝 SSH key／反向隧道；Cursor 已下架並促更新清理。
stories.summary_en: Fake Claude Code 2.1.313 lived ~11h on Cursor marketplace pushing SSH backdoor; pulled; users urged to update/cleanup.
stories.why_it_matters: 開發工具鏈被投毒會間接影響金鑰同部署安全；Crypto 團隊同樣要核對擴充來源。

stories.title: Ansem 於 Pump.fun 永續開約 88 萬美元 10x 空 SOL
stories.title_en: Ansem Opens $880K 10x Short on SOL Amid $ANSEM Token Crash
stories.summary: Ansem 用 Pump.fun 新永續（接 Hyperliquid）開大約 88 萬美元 10x 空 SOL；同期 $ANSEM 市值由高位急挫。
stories.summary_en: Ansem opened ~$880k 10x SOL short via Pump.fun perps (Hyperliquid); $ANSEM plunged from peak mcap.
stories.why_it_matters: 意見領袖槓桿倉會放大 SOL／meme 波動同情緒；非基本面訊號。

stories.title: SPX6900 社群持續加倉、市值約 3.4 億美元
stories.title_en: SPX6900 Memecoin Thrives on Relentless Community Positivity
stories.summary: 以太坊諷刺 meme SPX6900 靠社群信念支撐，持有者晒 DCA；近期現貨大額買盤同細注並存，價約 $0.36。
stories.summary_en: SPX6900 culture-driven meme holds ~$340M; DCA posts and large spot buys; price ~$0.36.
stories.why_it_matters: 高信念 meme 在弱市仍吸金，反映風險資產輪動同敘事仍在。

stories.title: 交易員 Frank 了結逾千萬美元 memecoin 空倉
stories.title_en: Crypto Trader Frank Closes Million-Dollar Memecoin Shorts
stories.summary: Frank 平掉約 1230 萬美元槓桿空倉（含 BTC／ZEC／NEAR／PUMP），談及持倉心理壓力；meme 總市值遠低於 2024 高峰。
stories.summary_en: Frank closed ~$12.3M leveraged shorts (BTC/ZEC/NEAR/PUMP) after profits; memecoin mcap far below 2024 peaks.
stories.why_it_matters: 大戶平倉會短暫改變流動性同情緒；反映 meme 季仍偏防守。

stories.title: Druckenmiller 撐 trade[XYZ] 與 ICE／Hyperliquid 美期貨合作
stories.title_en: Stan Druckenmiller Backs trade[XYZ] in ICE-Hyperliquid U.S. Futures Deal
stories.summary: ICE 宣佈與 trade[XYZ]、Hyperliquid 合作推受規管 24/7 永續（待 CFTC）；Druckenmiller 表態支持，HYPE 一度急升逾一成。
stories.summary_en: ICE partners with trade[XYZ]/Hyperliquid for regulated 24/7 perps (CFTC pending); Druckenmiller supportive; HYPE jumped >10%.
stories.why_it_matters: 傳統交易所入場敘事可驅動 HYPE／永續板塊估值重估。

stories.title: Strategy 改以優先股為主籌資買 BTC
stories.title_en: Strategy Details Preferred Stock Shift for Bitcoin Buys Amid Earnings Volatility
stories.summary: Q3 電話會：將主要發 STRC 等數位信貸買 BTC，普通股僅用於股息／利息；持倉約 84.8 萬 BTC，股價震盪。
stories.summary_en: MSTR to fund BTC mainly via preferred/digital credit; common stock limited; ~848k BTC; shares volatile.
stories.why_it_matters: 企業囤幣融資結構影響 BTC 需求敘事同 MSTR 槓桿風險。

stories.title: Coinbase Q3 盈利 7.19 億美元、加倉比特幣庫存
stories.title_en: Coinbase Reports $719 Million Q3 Profit with Bitcoin Treasury Growth
stories.summary: 淨利大部分來自加密資產未變現收益；交易收入回落，訂閱／預測市場上升；BTC 庫存增至約 1.8 萬枚。
stories.summary_en: Q3 NI $719M largely unrealized crypto gains; tx revenue down, subscriptions/prediction markets up; BTC treasury ~17,954.
stories.why_it_matters: 上市 CEX 業績同庫存決策係市場風險偏好風向標。

stories.title: 香港持牌穩定幣 HKDAP 登陸 Solana
stories.title_en: Anchorpoint Brings HKD Stablecoin HKDAP to Solana Blockchain
stories.summary: Anchorpoint（渣打香港／HKT／Animoca 背景）將 HKDAP 由以太坊 beta 擴至 Solana，方便亞洲支付同 RWA 結算。
stories.summary_en: HKMA-licensed Anchorpoint expands HKDAP to Solana for faster Asian payments/RWA settlement.
stories.why_it_matters: 非美元穩定幣上 Solana 有助亞洲結算同鏈上流動性結構。

stories.title: Monad 公開對抗 AI 攻擊嘅 OpSec 工具包
stories.title_en: Monad Shares Security Tools and Guides Against AI-Powered Crypto Threats
stories.summary: 發布 Crypto OpSec Bible 同開源 Ultrafuzz；數據指社工／控制權劫持損失遠超合約漏洞。
stories.summary_en: Monad released OpSec Bible + open-source Ultrafuzz; social-engineering losses dwarf contract bugs.
stories.why_it_matters: 強調金鑰／裝置管理優先於純合約審計；團隊運維風險上升。

stories.title: 觀點：AGI 時代 meme 或比工具幣更耐用
stories.title_en: Memecoins Seen Outlasting Utility Tokens in AGI Era
stories.summary: Murad 等認為 AGI 可複製程式效用，但難複製社群文化同線下聚會；批評者指多數 meme 最終歸零。
stories.summary_en: Murad argues AGI can't replicate meme culture/IRL gatherings; skeptics note most memes still die.
stories.why_it_matters: 敘事會影響資金偏好；模擬選幣宜分開文化幣同工具幣邏輯。

stories.title: 開發者逆向 Pump.fun 合約遭律師信
stories.title_en: Solana Developer Faces Cease-and-Desist for Reverse-Engineering Pump.fun Contracts
stories.summary: Shaw 公開 Pump.fun 閉源合約逆向結果後收到 Bracket 律師信；佢主張字節碼公開並促開源。
stories.summary_en: Shaw got C&D after reverse-engineering Pump.fun contracts; argues bytecode is public, wants open source.
stories.why_it_matters: 發射台透明度同法律風險影響 Solana meme 基建信任。

stories.title: Trezor 警告 Safe 5 遭植入硬體竊聽板
stories.title_en: Trezor Warns of Hardware Implant in Safe 5 from Former Reseller
stories.summary: 印尼用戶從前經銷商 CryptoBilis 買到嘅 Safe 5 夾咗可經流動網絡外傳助記詞嘅電路板；Trezor 已斷絕合作並呼籲相關買家即時轉倉。
stories.summary_en: A Safe 5 bought via former reseller CryptoBilis hid a cellular implant that can exfiltrate the recovery phrase; Trezor cut ties and urges affected buyers to move funds.
stories.why_it_matters: 供應鏈植入直接打穿冷錢包假設；自託管用戶要核對來源同韌體。

stories.title: Polymarket 第三方腳本被入侵損失約 270 萬美元
stories.title_en: Polymarket Halts Trading After Third-Party Hack Drains $2.7 Million
stories.summary: DebugBear 監控腳本被植入惡意碼，登入 session 被盜後約一小時停市；平台已退款大部分用戶並補償交易損失。
stories.summary_en: A DebugBear monitoring script was injected; ~$2.7M drained via hijacked sessions before a trading halt; Polymarket refunded users and added trading-loss cover.
stories.why_it_matters: 金融站嵌第三方 JS 一樣有資金風險；預測市場同 DeFi 前端都受影響。

stories.title: Aave 於幣安被盜後重開借貸市場
stories.title_en: Aave Reopens Lending Markets After Binance Breach Freeze
stories.summary: 攻擊者向 Aave V3 注入約 6000 萬 USDT 並借入 WETH；Aave 曾凍結 16 網絡 292 儲備，其後分階段重開，部分資產暫設限制。
stories.summary_en: Attackers funneled ~$60M USDT into Aave V3 and borrowed WETH; Aave froze 292 reserves across 16 networks then reopened in stages with temporary limits.
stories.why_it_matters: DeFi 風控工具（凍結 vs 隔離市場）會影響借貸流動性同穩定幣溢價。

stories.title: 新加坡警方針對零售通路被改裝 Ledger
stories.title_en: Singapore Police Warn of Tampered Ledger Wallets in Retail Stores
stories.summary: 至少兩宗受害人從本地店舖買到植入惡意元件嘅 Ledger，損失約 270 萬美元；警方同 Ledger 呼籲核對包裝並直接向原廠購買。
stories.summary_en: Tampered Ledgers sold in some Singapore retail outlets stole seeds; ~$2.7M lost across victims; buy direct and verify packaging.
stories.why_it_matters: 東南亞零售硬體錢包供應鏈風險上升，同 Trezor 事件形成區域模式。

stories.title: Coinbase 上架 Ripple RLUSD 穩定幣
stories.title_en: Coinbase Lists Ripple's RLUSD Stablecoin for U.S. Users
stories.summary: 美區零售／交易所／Prime 均可 1:1 兌換；RLUSD 市值約 26 億、近 90 日淨流入逾 10 億，覆蓋 XRPL／ETH／Base。
stories.summary_en: Coinbase listed RLUSD across retail, exchange, and Prime; ~$2.6B mcap with strong inflows on XRPL, Ethereum, and Base.
stories.why_it_matters: 穩定幣競爭格局再變，影響兌換路徑同機構結算選擇。

stories.title: Solana RWA 規模破 51.9 億美元並接 Polygon
stories.title_en: Solana RWA Value Tops $5 Billion with Polygon Integration
stories.summary: 鏈上 RWA 由一年前不足 10 億升至約 51.9 億；Polygon Open Money Stack 接入 Solana，方便企業統一管理存款同穩定幣出金。
stories.summary_en: Solana RWA ~$5.19B; Polygon Open Money Stack adds Solana for unified deposits/stablecoin payouts across chains.
stories.why_it_matters: RWA／跨鏈支付基建成熟度上升，同 meme 盤資金面分流有關。

stories.title: Shopify 商家經 Coinbase 協議結算 4200 萬 USDC
stories.title_en: Shopify Merchants Settle $42 Million in USDC Payments via Coinbase Protocol
stories.summary: Base 上開源 Commerce Payments Protocol 讓合資格商家收穩定幣並定時兌本地法幣；已逾 44.8 萬筆、無 gas 體驗。
stories.summary_en: Shopify+Coinbase Commerce Payments Protocol on Base: $42M settled across 448k payments with gas covered for shoppers.
stories.why_it_matters: 穩定幣由轉帳走向日常消費結算，驗證零售需求。

stories.title: 代幣化股票市值達 46.3 億美元
stories.title_en: Tokenized Stocks Hit $4.63 Billion Milestone Echoing Early Stablecoins
stories.summary: 由年初不足 10 億急升；Binance bStocks／Ondo／xStocks 佔約 81%，BNB Chain 領先，DTCC 鏈上服務亦啟用。
stories.summary_en: Tokenized equities ~$4.63B YTD surge; bStocks/Ondo/xStocks ~81% share; DTCC on-chain service live with major banks.
stories.why_it_matters: 傳統資產上鏈規模接近早期穩定幣拐點敘事，影響交易所產品線。

stories.title: 比特幣佔比回落、山寨有輪動跡象
stories.title_en: Bitcoin Dominance Dips as Altcoins Show Signs of Surge
stories.summary: BTC.D 約 60.1%，alt 佔比回升；交易員談論資金輪動，altseason 指數仍中性約 56–59。
stories.summary_en: BTC dominance ~60.1% with talk of rotation into alts; altseason index still neutral ~56–59.
stories.why_it_matters: 佔比轉弱常伴隨山寨／meme 波動放大，係盤面風險偏好指標。

stories.title: 摩斯密碼提示注入令 AI 錢包代理被盜約 15–20 萬
stories.title_en: Morse Code Trick Drains $150K from AI Wallet Agent
stories.summary: 公開帖文隱藏指令經 Grok 轉譯後觸發 Bankrbot 轉帳；凸顯 AI agent 控錢包嘅 prompt injection 風險。
stories.summary_en: Hidden Morse instruction on X was decoded into a Bankrbot transfer of ~$150–200k; classic prompt-injection on AI wallet agents.
stories.why_it_matters: AI 代理一旦有簽名權，公開內容都能變成提款指令。

stories.title: 少年騙徒假冒客服盜 1300 萬 BTC 判 25 個月
stories.title_en: Teen Scammer Sentenced for $13M Bitcoin Heist via Fake Support Call
stories.summary: 加拿大籍 Trenton Johnston 冒充 Google／Trezor 客服騙取 185 BTC；已退還部分並被判 25 個月及遞解。
stories.summary_en: Teen scammer stole 185 BTC via fake Google/Trezor support; 25 months, partial restitution, deportation.
stories.why_it_matters: 社交工程仍然係大額自託管失竊主因，重申永不交出種子。

stories.title: 幣安被盜後社群玩梗叫黑客去搞 Pump.fun
stories.title_en: Crypto Users Urge Binance Hackers to Target Pump.fun
stories.summary: 約 63 億級熱錢包事件後，用戶以梗圖呼籲黑客下一步打 launchpad；幣安稱 SAFU 覆蓋、穩定幣方已凍部分贓款。
stories.summary_en: After the Binance hot-wallet breach, satirical posts urged hackers toward Pump.fun; Binance cited SAFU; stables froze part of loot.
stories.why_it_matters: 反映市場對低質 launchpad 嘅情緒，同時提醒中心化熱錢包風險。
